s0007: Market grows in value, but the mix is shifting
s0021: The pharma market is growing in value, but unit demand is falling. Prices are rising in 2026: the average pack price is up to **RUB 432.5** (+14.8% vs January–August 2025). The average pharmacy receipt in Russia across the full range (incl. drugs and parapharmacy) reached **RUB 888.5** in August 2026 (+15% vs August 2025).
s0023: Prescription drugs are the main growth engine: they are growing in value and account for most of the market’s sales. The OTC segment, by contrast, faces falling demand. High-cost drugs are reshaping the market fast: Tirzepta sales topped **RUB 15.9 bn** in six months, and Sedjaro grew **87-fold**.
